results.reason: The request challenges whether to build a new integration at all, which is exactly the go/no-go scope of feature-interrogation.
Asking to reduce 14 boolean props and an event bus without losing behavior is a direct least-code simplification request.
Writing acceptance criteria before implementation is the stated purpose of acceptance-criteria.
Reviewing a pull request for correctness and contract risk is code-review's core job.
Intermittent production 502s that need actual root-cause diagnosis match debug-root-cause directly.
Splitting a large service without changing behavior is precisely refactor-safely.
Deciding how to test a flow given limited time and few tests is a test-strategy decision.
Auditing uploads and admin endpoints before internet exposure is explicitly in security-review's scope.
Slow dashboard and API latency targets call for measured performance work, which performance-engineering covers.
A zero-downtime column rename on a huge table is exactly the schema migration case migration-safety handles.
Designing endpoints, errors, pagination, and versioning for a partner API is api-contract's remit.
Removing purple-gradient, three-card, 'seamless' landing page sameness is literally anti-ai-slop.
Rewriting an error message to tell a user what to do next is clear-writing's stated use case.
Splitting a mixed branch into reviewable commits and writing the PR description is pr-craft.
A WCAG failure on keyboard, labels, and focus is the direct target of accessibility-audit.
Consolidating eleven button variants and raw hex values into a minimal design system is design-system-discipline.
Janky modal animation and gratuitous hover scaling are motion quality decisions, matching motion-quality.
Specifying logs, metrics, traces, and alerts before on-call is exactly observability-first.
A Friday deploy go/no-go with named blockers is the release-readiness gate.
Deciding whether to add date-fns and auditing package.json is dependency-hygiene's core question.
Replicating a screenshot exactly in HTML/CSS is the pixel-fidelity recreation image-to-ui describes.
A trivially stated CSS fix for a Safari-only button break does not clearly need a diagnostic or design skill.
Optimizing a query that scans two million rows falls under performance-engineering's explicit 'optimizing a query' scope.
Generating twenty unit tests is a mechanical task, and test-strategy is about deciding what and where to test rather than bulk test authoring.
Writing a small email validation function with tests fits no listed skill.
Adding structured logging and a dashboard is explicitly named in observability-first.
Renaming one local variable is too small for refactor-safely and needs no skill.
The flaky test is mentioned in test-strategy's scope, but the request is a narrow timeout workaround rather than suite strategy.
A GDPR cookie consent banner is compliance work that no listed skill covers.
Infrastructure cost reduction is neither latency nor throughput performance-engineering, and no cost skill is listed.
Writing a reporting SQL query is not a migration or schema change.
Calling the Stripe API is integration usage, whereas api-contract is about designing APIs, not consuming them.
Translation is not covered by clear-writing, which addresses authoring and rewriting rather than translating.
Summarizing a PDF into bullets is a generic reading task with no matching skill.
Resolving a merge conflict is not PR shaping or commit splitting, so pr-craft does not apply.
Making a logo bigger and moving it is a trivial visual tweak with no accessibility or design-system scope.
Brand palette and logo direction are identity work, not design-system token or component discipline.
A CSS-only spinner touches loading motion, but the ask is straightforward implementation rather than motion quality decisions.
CI pipeline setup is build automation, not logging, metrics, tracing, or alerting.
A changelog is close to the release notes clear-writing explicitly names, though it could be routine bookkeeping.
A Node runtime upgrade is a platform migration, not dependency keep-or-remove hygiene.
Designing a dashboard from scratch is not image-based recreation, so image-to-ui does not fit.
